step: Bug: a fresh visitor saw 'loading…' and an empty city list (test user rating 0)
cause: GET /api/operate/cities loads every config/cities/*.yaml through a strict schema inside one request; the copy of the server on port 8011 (started 2026-10-05 22:27 with older code) refuses today's config files and answers 500, and the page kept 'loading…' with no city because the frontend showed nothing on a failed list
fix: backend/app/routing/router.py: each config is loaded on its own; a refused file is reported under `problems` and skipped, the default city is always one of the served cities, and the registry/observatory part cannot take the list down either
frontend/src/lib/city.tsx exposes `error`, `loading`, `reload`; app/AppShell.tsx shows 'The city list could not be loaded (…) Try again' instead of the page

tests: backend/tests/city/test_city_list.py (a broken file beside dhaka.yaml → 200, dhaka served, broken reported, one default; the checked-in configs → no problems, one default with a centre); frontend/src/lib/city.test.tsx (fresh browser, nothing stored → the default city; a 500 → the reason shown; an empty list → the problems shown)
checked: fresh visitor (localStorage and sessionStorage cleared) on the current server: /emergency shows Dhaka selected, Bangla, numbers and the ambulance sentence (fresh_visitor_emergency.jpg)
the old server on 8011 with the new build: the page now says 'The city list could not be loaded (Internal Server Error)…' with Try again, instead of 'loading…'
not_checked: a truly separate Chrome profile (the extension works in the owner's profile; storage was cleared instead)
the old server itself is not changed: restart it to serve the current code
